details.description:
Some nights your body is done but your mind isn't. The day replays itself, the phone comes back out, and 11pm quietly becomes 1am.
Vicks ZzzQuil Natura is a tasty strawberry sleep gummy that helps you fall asleep. Take one gummy 30 minutes before bed. That's the whole routine.
What's in it
Each gummy contains 5 mg melatonin, the same sleep signal your body already makes at night, plus 50 mg natural ashwagandha.
A gummy, not a tablet
No water. No bitter aftertaste. Real strawberry taste and vegetarian, so bedtime feels less like taking something and more like winding down.
Non-habit forming
ZzzQuil Natura is non-habit forming. Take it on the nights you need it and skip the nights you don't. There's no course to finish. Once a week or a few times a month is perfectly normal.
How to take it
Take 1 gummy 30 minutes before bedtime and allow more than 6 hours of sleep. Do not drive or operate machinery after taking it.
